newsitem.title: USA: Ford increases rebate on Contour, Mystique.
newsitem.headline: Ford increases rebate on Contour, Mystique.

text.p: Ford Motor Co on Friday said it raised its retail incentive on the 1997 Ford Contour and the Mercury Mystique and cut 24-month financing rates on various Ford and Lincoln-Mercury cars.
Ford said it increased the size of its rebate on the Countour to $750 from $500, and its rebate on the Mystique to $600 from $400.

Incentives on other cars were unchanged, ranging from $300 for the Ford Thurderbird to $1,500 for Ford Econolines with certain packages. The rebate on the top-selling Ford Taurus is unchanged at $1,000.

Finance rates for purchases financed through Ford Credit for 48 months ranged from 4.9 percent to 7.9 percent, and Ford said it cut its lowest 24-month rate on the majority of its cars to 2.9 percent from 3.9 percent.
